# chainlink

`chainlink` derives price and volume measures of national accounts,
following chapter 8 of the IMF *Quarterly National Accounts Manual*:

- Laspeyres-type, Paasche-type and Fisher-type volume indices from
  current prices and price indices
  ([`cp_pi2vol()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/cp_pi2vol.md),
  [`laspeyres()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/fixed_weight_indices.md),
  [`paasche()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/fixed_weight_indices.md),
  [`fisher()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/fixed_weight_indices.md));
- chain-linking of quarterly or monthly volume indices with the annual
  overlap and the one-quarter overlap techniques
  ([`chain_link()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/chain_link.md),
  [`chain_laspeyres()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/chain_laspeyres.md),
  [`annual_chain()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/chain_link.md));
- exact contributions to percent change of chain-linked volume measures,
  over the previous period, over the same period of the previous year or
  for the annual growth
  ([`chain_contrib()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/chain_contrib.md));
- non-additivity of chain-linked series
  ([`chain_discrepancy()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/chain_discrepancy.md)),
  change of the reference year
  ([`chain_rebase()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/chain_rebase.md))
  and pseudo chain series for variables that change sign
  ([`chain_pseudo()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/chain_pseudo.md));
- un-chaining and aggregation of chain-linked series, for the indirect
  seasonal adjustment of Laspeyres-type series
  ([`chain_unchain()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/chain_unchain.md),
  [`chain_aggregate()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/chain_unchain.md)).

All the functions use `ts` objects. The benchmarking of the quarterly
series on annual data is not implemented: use for example the
[`tempdisagg`](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=tempdisagg) package
(see the vignette `imf_qna_manual`).

## Installation

You can install the development version of `chainlink` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/AQLT/chainlink) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("AQLT/chainlink")
```

## Example

The data of the example 8.2 of the manual are two products, `A` and `B`,
with current prices (`imf_cp`) and price indices over the previous year
(`imf_pi`):

``` r

library(chainlink)
imf_cp
#>             A     B
#> 2010 Q1 150.0 225.0
#> 2010 Q2 150.0 225.0
#> 2010 Q3 150.0 225.0
#> 2010 Q4 150.0 225.0
#> 2011 Q1 159.7 218.9
#> 2011 Q2 163.2 213.7
#> 2011 Q3 167.4 210.6
#> 2011 Q4 169.7 211.7
#> 2012 Q1 174.2 204.1
#> 2012 Q2 180.4 201.4
#> 2012 Q3 188.9 192.3
#> 2012 Q4 215.5 171.7
#> 2013 Q1 224.7 166.0
#> 2013 Q2 235.8 156.3
#> 2013 Q3 242.9 148.5
#> 2013 Q4 245.4 144.8
```

Chain-linked Laspeyres-type volume measures of the products and of the
total, with the annual overlap technique and 2010 as reference year:

``` r

x <- chain_laspeyres(imf_cp, imf_pi, method = "ao", base_year = 2010,
                     output = "measure")
round(x, 1)
#>             A     B Total
#> 2011 Q1 156.6 221.1 377.7
#> 2011 Q2 159.2 218.1 377.3
#> 2011 Q3 162.5 214.9 377.4
#> 2011 Q4 164.8 213.8 378.6
#> 2012 Q1 165.6 213.6 379.4
#> 2012 Q2 172.3 206.5 379.3
#> 2012 Q3 182.2 198.2 381.3
#> 2012 Q4 206.9 176.1 384.8
#> 2013 Q1 214.2 171.4 388.6
#> 2013 Q2 227.0 159.8 390.8
#> 2013 Q3 235.0 151.0 390.7
#> 2013 Q4 238.6 146.6 390.1
```

Contributions of the products to the quarter-to-quarter growth of the
total, and the non-additivity residual:

``` r

round(chain_contrib(x, imf_cp, method = "ao", extra = c("total", "residual")), 3)
#>             A      B  Total Residual
#> 2011 Q1    NA     NA     NA       NA
#> 2011 Q2 0.702 -0.808 -0.106        0
#> 2011 Q3 0.876 -0.838  0.038        0
#> 2011 Q4 0.592 -0.281  0.311        0
#> 2012 Q1 0.248 -0.041  0.207        0
#> 2012 Q2 1.817 -1.835 -0.017        0
#> 2012 Q3 2.673 -2.158  0.516        0
#> 2012 Q4 6.615 -5.701  0.913        0
#> 2013 Q1 2.082 -1.077  1.005        0
#> 2013 Q2 3.440 -2.887  0.553        0
#> 2013 Q3 2.136 -2.156 -0.020        0
#> 2013 Q4 0.966 -1.109 -0.143        0
```

Contributions to the growth over the same quarter of the previous year:

``` r

round(chain_contrib(x, imf_cp, method = "ao", type = "yoy"), 3)
#>              A       B
#> 2011 Q1     NA      NA
#> 2011 Q2     NA      NA
#> 2011 Q3     NA      NA
#> 2011 Q4     NA      NA
#> 2012 Q1  2.419  -1.970
#> 2012 Q2  3.548  -3.009
#> 2012 Q3  5.357  -4.338
#> 2012 Q4 11.409  -9.783
#> 2013 Q1 13.261 -10.826
#> 2013 Q2 14.971 -11.951
#> 2013 Q3 14.419 -11.949
#> 2013 Q4  8.707  -7.310
```

## Vignettes

- [`vignette("imf_qna_manual")`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/articles/imf_qna_manual.md)
  reproduces the examples of the chapter 8 of the manual and gives the
  correspondence between the examples and the functions;
- [`vignette("contributions")`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/articles/contributions.md)
  details the contributions to percent change;
- [`vignette("practical_case")`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/articles/practical_case.md)
  follows a complete workflow, from raw quarterly data to the published
  series and contributions.

# Package index

## Volume indices from current prices and price indices

- [`cp_pi2vol()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/cp_pi2vol.md)
  : Elementary volume indices
- [`cp_pi2cy()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/cp_pi2cy.md)
  : Values at the average prices of the year
- [`laspeyres()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/fixed_weight_indices.md)
  [`paasche()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/fixed_weight_indices.md)
  [`fisher()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/fixed_weight_indices.md)
  : Laspeyres, Paasche and Fisher volume indices
- [`pi_py2pp()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/pi_py2pp.md)
  : Price indices over the previous period
- [`pi_annual()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/pi_annual.md)
  : Annual price indices

## Chain-linking

- [`chain_laspeyres()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/chain_laspeyres.md)
  : Chain-linked Laspeyres-type volume series of a total and its
  components
- [`chain_link()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/chain_link.md)
  [`annual_chain()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/chain_link.md)
  : Chain-linking
- [`chain_rebase()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/chain_rebase.md)
  : Change the reference year of chain-linked series
- [`chain_pseudo()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/chain_pseudo.md)
  : Pseudo chain volume series of a variable that changes sign
- [`chain_unchain()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/chain_unchain.md)
  [`chain_aggregate()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/chain_unchain.md)
  : Un-chain and aggregate chain-linked volume measures

## Contributions and non-additivity

- [`chain_contrib()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/chain_contrib.md)
  : Contributions to percent change of chain-linked volume measures
- [`chain_discrepancy()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/chain_discrepancy.md)
  : Non-additivity of chain-linked volume measures
- [`fisher_contrib()`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/fisher_contrib.md)
  : Contributions to percent change of a Fisher volume index

## Data

- [`imf_cp`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/data_manual.md)
  [`imf_pi`](https://aqlt.github.io/chainlink/reference/data_manual.md)
  : Data of the IMF Quarterly National Accounts Manual (chapter 8)
